title: Field intake signal distiller and mini-scoping brief
creator: Priya Shah
description:
Summary: Create a repeatable 'distillation' workflow for Sales/CS to aggregate enterprise feature requests into compact, action-ready mini-scopes (aka 'mini-RFEs') that include a 1-page solution sketch, preliminary cost proxy, acceptance criteria, and recommended delivery path. Goal is to reduce ambiguity and handoff friction so Eng/Platform can review with <30m asynchronous context per request.

Scope: This ticket covers the playbook, triage rubric, a prototype spreadsheet + small Notion template, and a pilot run with 10 recent high-touch requests. Not included: full dev specs, final PRs, or implementation work.

Why: Current enterprise intake arrives as long threads and meetings; PM/Eng spend >2 hours per ask to create scoping notes. Standardizing a compact artifact will speed throughput, improve prioritization signals, and enable consistent cost proxies for Dedicated/Private asks.

Deliverables:
- Distillation rubric (scoring formula and thresholds)
- Mini-RFE template (one-page: problem, customer-sample, proposed change, acceptance criteria, cost proxy, recommended owner)
- Quick routing map (Quick-Ship / Scoped-MVP / Program) with definitions and example SLAs
- Pilot run dataset: 10 aggregated requests and resulting mini-RFEs
- Handoff checklist for ENG/Design reviews

Mini-RFE structure (1 page):
- Title (one-line)
- Customer(s) & cohort (names + ARR band)
- Problem statement (<=2 sentences)
- Proposed solution sketch (bullets + required surface area: API/Console/Runtime)
- Acceptance criteria (3)
- Cost proxy (tokens/hr, infra band: Hosted/Dedicated/Private)
- Estimated effort class (Quick-Ship <=2w, Scoped-MVP 2-8w, Program 8+w)
- Strategic notes (GA impact, multi-account demand)

Distillation rubric (novel): score = round( (ARR_weight*0.4 + Request_frequency*0.3 + Strategic_alignment*0.2 + (1 - Implementation_risk)*0.1) * Cohort_multiplier , 2)
- ARR_weight: 0-1 normalized by ARR band (0: <50k, 0.5: 50-250k, 1: >250k)
- Request_frequency: 0-1 (unique accounts / month requesting similar capability)
- Strategic_alignment: 0-1 (0: low, 1: core platform fit)
- Implementation_risk: 0-1 (1: high risk)
- Cohort_multiplier: 1.0 for Small, 1.2 for Mid-market, 1.5 for High-touch enterprise
Thresholds: Score >=0.9 => Program, 0.6-0.9 => Scoped-MVP, <0.6 => Quick-Ship or decline.

Acceptance criteria (for this ticket):
1) Distillation rubric and template documented in Notion and reviewed by Sales, CS, PM, and Eng (sign-off from each)
2) Pilot run produces 10 mini-RFEs with score distribution and routing recommendations; at least 2 routed to Scoped-MVP and 1 to Program for follow-up
3) Handoff checklist validated in two actual ENG/Design async reviews (time to first-context <=30 minutes)

Success metrics (post-pilot):
- Avg. pre-handoff PM/ENG context time reduced from 120m to <=30m per request
- Time from ask to routing decision <=5 business days for high-touch accounts
- Increase in high-confidence scoped asks delivered to ENG backlog by 40% over baseline

Notes on recommended delivery paths (examples):
- Quick-Ship: Console copy, toggle, or small API param change (<=2w)
- Scoped-MVP: API change + Console surface + 1 runtime compatibility check (2-8w)
- Program: Cross-team work, runtime/architecture changes, potential Dedicated/Private workstream (8+w)

Edge cases: Multi-account asks with conflicting requirements should be broken into account-specific mini-RFEs and a consolidated Program-level brief. Security-sensitive asks must include KMS/data residency flags and route to Private early.

10 pilot mini-RFEs produced with routing recommendations
